canopy_deg.note: geared drive + torsion counterbalance; latch released at t=0.16 s

tray_cam.note: one cam plate: first quarter-turn lifts 14 mm, second advances 8 mm; also flips the wheels up

key_cam_deg.note: 25-lobe camshaft, lobes phased 7.5 deg apart; dwell holds keys up

panel_front_mm.note: lead screw (8 mm lead), scissor only guides

panel_rear_mm.note: rear rises 15.9 mm more = 0.20 rad tilt over 80 mm

knob_bar_mm.note: lost-motion slots 1.75 mm apart stagger the 9 knobs; 7.5 mm-pitch helix turns each knob once

podL_yaw_deg.note: wrist turntable in pod; tilt is passive (parallel link)

podR_yaw_deg.note: wrist turntable in pod; tilt is passive (parallel link)

interlocks: panel may not rise until canopy is at least 85 deg open
keyboard tray may not lift until canopy is clear
canopy may not close unless left pod is docked
canopy may not close unless right pod is docked
canopy may not close unless panel is fully down
canopy may not close unless tray is stowed
